policy: The active research fleet is restricted to H43, resolver-source residual observers, the certified payoff graph, rule-aware cross-venue products and the exact-expiry Deribit surface. Parked specifications remain immutable and queryable as controls, cannot be inverted or promoted, and may only be redesigned under a new strategy id and evidence epoch.

dispositions.reason: Generic all-market taker scoring has not demonstrated post-cost alpha and is parked while its raw L2 capture remains available.
The generic predictor is a falsified control, not an alpha candidate.
Generic passive making has not demonstrated queue- and toxicity-adjusted profit.
Modeled rewards are not authenticated account rewards and cannot support promotion.
Paired making has not demonstrated profit without modeled rewards and remains a paper-only control.
Generic public-flow continuation was negative after executable round-trip costs.
Blind flow inversion is not the economic opposite of the failed continuation trade and remains a negative control.
The generic flow scalp has not produced a positive frozen forward cohort.
The post-selected final-ten-second arm remains unvalidated and is removed from active signal production.
Both cadence tests failed to demonstrate executable alpha.
The flow-confirmed family remains a falsified control.
The Phi-overreaction family has no validated post-cost edge.
The maker arm has not passed queue-aware forward evidence.
The taker arm has not passed executable-cost forward evidence.
Consistency is retained as a diagnostic feature rather than an independently promotable strategy.
Typed nested-threshold work is consolidated into structural_certified_payoff_graph_v3.
Typed disjoint-range work is consolidated into structural_certified_payoff_graph_v3.
Resolver-close distance is an input to separately registered resolver-source residual arms, not a standalone strategy.
Range resolver distance is retained for attribution, not independent promotion.
Ladder consistency is consolidated into the certified payoff graph.
Threshold velocity remains an attribution feature and is not an active alpha candidate.
Boundary migration remains an attribution feature and is not an active alpha candidate.
The accidental five-minute discovery did not establish an hourly mechanism and its five-minute successor failed forward validation.
MAIN remains paper-only operational telemetry; it is not a promotion candidate.
GEORGE remains paper-only operational telemetry; it is not a promotion candidate.
V3 is superseded by the separately scored V5 terminal-lock and risky-convergence products.
V4's short evidence window is superseded by a fresh 30-day V5 epoch.
The existing cross-venue funding switcher has not demonstrated synchronized executable post-fee profit.
V2 title algebra is superseded by content-addressed rule certification and deterministic payoff proof in V3.
